name: @chaoz23/inkbench
description: Neutral, reproducible planted-bug and real-story benchmarks for Ink search strategies.

scripts.corpus:smoke: node dist/cli.js corpus experiment --preset smoke --out artifacts/corpus-smoke
scripts.corpus:mature: node dist/cli.js corpus experiment --preset mature --out artifacts/corpus-mature --resume
scripts.corpus:marathon:20m: node dist/cli.js corpus experiment --preset marathon-20m --out artifacts/heresy2-marathon-20m --resume
scripts.corpus:marathon:60m: node dist/cli.js corpus experiment --preset marathon-60m --out artifacts/heresy2-marathon-60m --resume
scripts.mutants:smoke: node dist/cli.js mutants experiment --preset smoke --out artifacts/intercept-20-smoke
scripts.mutants:development: node dist/cli.js mutants experiment --preset development --out artifacts/intercept-20-development --isolated --resume
scripts.mutants:mature: node dist/cli.js mutants experiment --preset mature --out artifacts/intercept-20-mature --resume
scripts.mutants:marathon:20m: node dist/cli.js mutants experiment --preset marathon-20m --out artifacts/intercept-20-marathon-20m --resume
scripts.mutants:marathon:60m: node dist/cli.js mutants experiment --preset marathon-60m --out artifacts/intercept-20-marathon-60m --resume
scripts.longitudinal:smoke: node dist/cli.js longitudinal experiment --config examples/longitudinal-smoke.json --out artifacts/longitudinal-smoke --resume

author: Daniel Strader (chaoz23)
